contents: Public trial release, public guides and original brand cards; private operational source remains separate
release_scope: Standard-user host version labels retaining 0.8.8 approval guidance; privileged runtime remains 0.8.7 with 96 byte-identical resources. Server WAL/read snapshots, session socket isolation and fixed service_unavailable busy responses are applied separately; server changes are not distributed in this customer ZIP
verification_scope: 130.14-second local synthetic 50-member test: 350 renewals, 350 completed jobs, 24800 authenticated echoes, 1210 ledger reads and 21 reads during a held writer. ZIP CRC/source guard, 96 runtime pins, read-only startup and WebView checks. No real 50-PC, external network or long-running game continuity proof; earlier game observations remain historical
